title: Care grows towards mutual desire
meaning: Your partnership’s creative rhythm can nourish closeness when care still leaves room for a freely shared wish to be together.
text: Your union may have a warm, creative overall tone: beside each other, you want to grow things you both enjoy. In the physical position, the Empress appears through actions: arranging a space, sustaining a beginning and making everyday life more pleasant. In energy, the Empress describes the motive instead: wanting to see attention bear fruit and continue developing. In emotions, the Lovers bring a feeling of mutual openness. It matters that you share what you create with someone who freely responds, rather than simply uses the results of your care.

For example, you gradually make a balcony comfortable, choosing plants, finding a little table and leaving room for two cups. An evening spent there without further tasks feels especially pleasant. **What you create together becomes warmer when there is still time within it to meet each other.** Plants and comfortable chairs support that encounter without having to prove its value. Even an unfinished corner can become a favourite place where you are allowed simply to sit and talk.

The difficulty begins if developing your shared surroundings replaces developing the connection. One more purchase or alteration seems certain to make closeness fuller, so stopping becomes difficult. You care increasingly for a space for two while rarely inhabiting it without a task. A living response gets lost among improvements. Fruitfulness can also mean using the good things you have already grown.
